name_reason: Name follows the fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention and accurately reflects the behavior: it opens (displays modally) the character status screen for a given character. No Ghidra address residue in the name; 'char'/'status_screen' are semantic, not address-derived.
purpose: Display the character status screen modal for one character (stats + slide-in animation, optional usable-spell-list panel, then slide-out), then restore the screen and free its workspaces.
logic_summary: 1) fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in(char_idx) populates the stat display (HP/MP/AP/DP/EXP/Level) with slide-in. 2) fd2_wait_for_input_dialog_with_blink(0) waits for ACK. 3) spell_count = fd2_build_usable_spell_list(char_idx, NULL). If the character has usable spells: play open SFX (handle 6); 7-frame slide-in of the spell-list panel (each frame: memmove bg snapshot into accumulator, paint status panel layer-left(5) and layer-right(7), fd2_slide_panel_up_partial_step(iter*0x10+0x5E,...), flush accumulator to mode-13h VRAM 0xA0000); then a final static composite frame that additionally blits the spell-list sprite (sheet_offset[0x5A]) and calls fd2_draw_spell_selection_list(char_idx,-1,...) read-only; play ready SFX (handle 5); 7-frame reverse slide-out; fd2_wait_for_input_dialog_with_blink(0). Outro (always runs, frames 0..11): SFX (handle 6) on frame 0 and frame 7, then fd2_play_status_screen_outro_step per frame. Cleanup: memmove bg snapshot back to VRAM 0xA0000, then free the three 64000-byte workspaces (accumulator/bg-snapshot/composed-target).

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Character index/slot into the runtime character array (80B stride). From fd2_game_main_loop it is the result of fd2_find_char_at_cursor_pos() (char under the cursor); from fd2_run_status_screen_member_menu it is data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx (selected party member). Body forwards it to fd2_open_status_screen_with_slide_in, fd2_build_usable_spell_list, and fd2_draw_spell_selection_list as the character identifier.
params.reason: Live Ghidra parameter is the generic placeholder 'param_1' (needs_rename=true); its real meaning is the character index/slot. The src declaration already uses the accurate name 'char_idx'. Stage 2 should rename the Ghidra parameter param_1 -> char_idx to sync with the source. Recorded only; not applied this stage.

returns.semantics: No return value. void __cdecl with a compiler-injected __CHK(0x18) stack-probe prologue; the final free(composed_target) is emitted by Watcom as a tail call (JMP free).
